headline: Trump Declares "Crushing Economic Operation" Against Iran
summary: President Trump announced a 'crushing economic operation' against Iran, threatening countries that aid Iran. US sanctions and blockades have intensified amid stalled negotiations.
why: Sanctions and blockades on Iran affect global oil flows and trade with countries that do business with Iran, which matters for energy markets and companies with Iran exposure.
why_moved: Intensified sanctions and blockades and threats against countries aiding Iran raise uncertainty over Gulf oil flows and trade.
